title: In Splunk SOAR versions below 8.8.0, a user with permission to create and view containers for a label could use the…
description: In Splunk SOAR versions below 8.8.0, a user with permissions to create and view containers for a specific label can exploit the REST API to create a container referencing a workbook phase in a case they are not authorized to view. This leads to disclosure of the phase name and inconsistent phase associations due to insufficient authorization checks in the Container REST API during container creation.
